evidence: texture_check judged the fill bias on three cuts, the principal planes through the origin (web/src/llm/tools/index.ts:950-967): each hole a 4-connected component of a cut, its rim the ring around it in the plane (web/src/llm/metrics/texture.ts:84-86, :177-243), and the texture rule read each cut's systematic_fill_bias (web/src/llm/verdicts/rules.ts:464-475). A cut sees a hole as the section it cuts out of it: a hole crossed at its edge reads against a rim that lies off its node, where the diffuse is rounded, so one fill reads differently on two cuts, and a peak off those planes (a satellite) is crossed at its pole or not at all. On the Python half's lattice with satellites at (½, ½, 0.15) beside the nodes, all filled 12 % too high, the cut l = 0 reads the nodes at 0.28 of the level and the satellites, crossed at their poles, at 0.10 to 0.12, under the floor; the cut through the nodes' poles reads no bias at all (docs/pipeline.md, the fills' texture).
proposed_fix: Judge the fill bias by the volume's 3-D read (nebula3d.analysis.fill_texture, #55: GET /api/volumes/{id}/texture, webbridge.volume_texture_json), every punch hole with its 3-D rim, by the same rule, asking for the same limits (metrics/texture.ts). texture_check reports the summary over the holes; on a grid too coarse for the rims it measures no bias and says why (#60's not_judged, from the 3-D read), and with fewer than five holes judged it gives no verdict either. The cuts carry the azimuthal texture only. The texture rule reads the 3-D systematic_fill_bias; a result recorded by cut reads as before. A texture not judged, for the grid or for too few holes, keeps the run's verdict from met and says why, as G1 does for the ring removal: "not judged: the backfill's texture (grid too coarse)".

The criterion and its limits are batch 1's, unchanged. On the dev split the verdicts are as before. At 161 points all eight pass: the 3-D medians are 0 to 0.06σ and 0 to 0.015 of the level (dev-coverage, 16 holes: 0.35σ and 0.068), where the cuts read up to 0.9σ and 0.14 (dev-coverage, five holes a cut), and on the other seven the K–L plane at H = 0 read 0.2 to 0.6σ (0.03 to 0.12 of the level), the other two planes about 0.
